laws.title: Public Law 117–151: To amend title 11, United States Code, to modify the eligibility requirements for a debtor under chapter 13, and for other purposes.
laws.short_title: Bankruptcy Threshold Adjustment and Technical Corrections Act
laws.summary:
The law changed several title 11 definitions and cross-references. It inserted “under this title” in section 101(51D)(B)(i), replaced section 101(51D)(B)(iii), and added section 1182(1) to the cross-references in section 104(a) and section 104(b) [2022-117-151-101-4] [2022-117-151-101-5] [2022-117-151-104-1] [2022-117-151-104-2].

It rewrote section 109(e) to limit chapter 13 debtors to individuals with regular income owing less than $2,750,000 in noncontingent, liquidated debts, and it rewrote section 1182(1) with a longer definition for a person engaged in commercial or business activities [2022-117-151-109-1] [2022-117-151-1182-2].

It also changed subchapter V provisions in section 1183(b)(5) and section 1191(c) by adjusting the debtor-in-possession language, adding authority to operate the business, and splitting the payment-ability test and reasonable-likelihood test into separate subparagraphs [2022-117-151-1183-1] [2022-117-151-1183-2] [2022-117-151-1183-3] [2022-117-151-1183-4] [2022-117-151-1191-1].
